caption: The drawing features a central object that appears to be a hand stamp or seal, with a rounded, wood-textured brown handle and a metallic-looking, silvery gray base. The base is partially circular and has an attached knob on the right side. Below the main view is an oval design that appears to represent the stamp's engraved or embossed surface, featuring intricate decorative patterns and a heart shape at the center. Beneath this, three rectangular boxes show technical schematic diagrams: at the left, a simple oval viewed from above labeled "MYERS"; in the middle, a top-down view with dimensions given in inches and showing both the oval base and attached knob; at the right, a side profile view of the complete stamp with height and width measurements. The entire composition is contained within a large square or rectangular frame on a beige background with some light staining near the top left. The color palette consists primarily of shades of brown and gray, with line work in black.
title: Pewter Stamp
